summary: Verified fix for 'Rewards & Challenges' job count bug. _incentive_progress now whitelists kind in {completion, completion_cos}; cancellation / cancellation_cos / additional_work rows no longer inflate jobs_done. Validated at both the service layer (standalone script) and the public API (/api/partner/challenges and /api/partner/incentives) via OTP-authenticated Bearer token for seeded partner +919000000003.
critical_code_review_comments: services/partner_service.py::_incentive_progress fix is correct and minimal — whitelist on kind in {completion, completion_cos}. Good inline comment.

Minor: _incentive_progress loads all commission_ledger rows (to_list(2000)) client-side then filters in Python. Pushing {kind:{$in:['completion','completion_cos']}} and date range into the Mongo query would be more efficient for high-volume partners.
/api/partner/challenges returns dict ({challenges, stats, penalties}) while /api/partner/incentives returns a list — inconsistent shape, documented here for future callers/tests.

seed_data_creation: Inserted temporary commission_ledger rows with booking_code prefix 'TESTAGENT-' for the seeded partner; all cleaned up in test teardown (both success and failure paths).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest API tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_challenge_count_api.py and need REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env (used http://localhost:8001). Delta-based: counts jobs_done before and after inserting mixed-kind ledger rows and asserts +5 per challenge/incentive and +950 revenue per incentive. Also hits '/api/partner/challenges' which returns {challenges:[...], stats:{...}} (not a plain list).
